name: Final per-recipient dispatch guard
trigger: Mautic native queued, immediate or manual send

steps.action: Claim native send intent without bypassing Mautic ownership
Re-read eligibility, sender HOLD and approved revision
Atomically reserve per-sender and provider capacity
Submit through the only authorized production transport
Store accepted, rejected or UNKNOWN receipt
Reconcile before retry or reservation release

gate: Recipient, revision and quota valid at last boundary?
output: Guarded send attempt and durable receipt
acceptance_tests: Systemd rate limits alone are not per-recipient enforcement
notes: Custom integration to implement and test: supported Mautic transport decorator/plugin or equivalent final-boundary adapter. Ordinary Activepieces prechecks are insufficient.
failure: Set the affected marketing sender/campaign to HOLD; retain unknown acceptances and quota reservations pending reconciliation. Update authoritative suppression before releasing further sends.

run_contract.owner: Assigned accountable role in OpenProject before activation
run_contract.retry: Bounded retry only after retryability classification; unknown remote effects HOLD
run_contract.observability: workflow_id, run_id, correlation_id, state and redacted error; no raw PII labels
run_contract.recovery: Restore HOLD; reapply suppression/deletion and reconcile external receipts before replay
run_contract.completion: Named output plus acceptance evidence, not merely a running service
